company_info.company_description: "At Sungen, customer satisfaction is at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in our personalized approach, ensuring that each client receives dedicated support and guidance throughout their solar journey. Our team of experienced professionals is committed to delivering top-notch service, from initial consultation to system installation and ongoing maintenance.To deliver the highest quality solar solutions, we collaborate with industry-leading partners, ensuring that our customers have access to the latest technologies and innovations. Through strategic alliances and partnerships, we can offer cutting-edge solar panels, inverters, and monitoring systems that meet the highest standards of reliability and performance.Contact us today to explore how Sungen can help you harness the power of the sun and embark on a sustainable energy journey. Let's pave the way for a brighter and greener future, one solar panel at a time."

reviews.review_description: The installation process was professional fast and clean. Every step was explained in detail . Due to the number of technicians on the job the job was completed in just a few hours when I thought that it would take days.I also had a Tesla wall charger installed and that was a professional job as well.I cannot recommend this installer enough.I was very impressed.

Jackson and the team were great. The sales process went really well and they were patient with all of my ongoing questions. The price was very reasonable (slightly below some of the larger installers) and the installation happened as planned. The installation team were also very professional and tidy. Follow up service has been great as well, with Sungen being happy to answer any questions I have about the new system (I was very new to Solar).Happy to recommend Sungen. I actually recommended Sungen to my mother, who have also used Sungen to install solar and battery on her property.

Sungen provided a clear quote and tailored the system to my needs. The installation process was smooth and easy. I had a problem with one of the battery modules, and Sungen worked to fix it, but eventually swapped it out with a replacement. I therefore experienced the after sales customer care, and it too was great. Jackson, the owner, personally responded to my texts and calls and attended to things. I highly recommend Sungen.
Yes it was all installed well and very quick as well. Love the new system.

Liam from Sungen inspected our installation requirements and provided the most thorough quotation and feedback of all the suppliers considered. He was prompt to answer questions.The installation was done on time, to the day. Given the high demand for batteries and solar at the moment, I was pleasantly surprised that they were able to achieve this. The installers were clearly very busy but worked hard and to a professional standard. I also wanted to get our switchboard upgraded. They did this on the day, at a very competitive price.The whole installation is neat, tidy and professisonal. Trung did a great job explaining the monitoring app. He clearly takes great pride in the work he does. The system is working as expected, already reducing our power bills.I have no hesitation in recommending Sungen.

We recently had a 17.29kW solar system with a 40kW Sig battery installed by Sungen, and the whole experience has been excellent. After getting several quotes, we chose Sungen because of their professionalism, knowledge, and honest approach. Liam and Jackson were fantastic to deal with—no sales tactics, just clear advice and a straightforward plan.Laim took the time to explain the expected return on investment, timelines, which gave us confidence. The installation itself was smooth, quick, and hassle-free. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and delivered exactly what was promised. With our terracotta roof being complex, we were nervous about potential issues (some installers had turned us away), but Sungen handled it with care—only two tiles were broken in the process, which was a huge relief.Liam also made sure I understood how everything works, from the system setup to the savings we could expect. The monitoring app is simple and user-friendly, making it easy to track both usage and generation.Sungen exceeded our expectations at every step—professional service, quality installation, and total peace of mind.Choosing a solar provider is a big financial decision, and we’re very glad we trusted Sungen with ours.

Great installation by Sungen, The whole process was smooth from quote to install, really nice to see that they turn up in person to provide a quote.Installers on the day were super helpful and even fixed some items that were not part of the job.Overall a pleasure to do business with.

Sungen gave a great first impression right from the start, being the only one of the 3 Solar companies we contacted to even offer to have someone come out and do a site inspection as part of the initial quote process. In fact, they even suggested it, right off the bat. Another company I requested it, and never heard back about getting an inspection done.So not only did they see our tricky roof, but sent up a drone to take proper, measurable pics to get a much more accurate idea of what was possible for our roof, meaning no misleading ‘guesstimate’ quotes. They were the only ones to tell us we wouldn’t be able to get the size of system we initially wanted, without compromising on things and risking damaging the roof.In terms of pricing they were competitive and even beat the only other quote we were considering, so that, along with their initial first impression and more accurate assessment lead us to go with them.Install was all done in a day, ending with the battery all hooked up and working, and a quick demo of how the house doesn’t even notice being disconnected from the grid. Very handy since we had a planned outage in the street booked for later in the month, and as we work from home this means we’ll be unaffected. They set up the app for us and I’ve been monitoring things through the day, and gave tweaked the settings to ensure we charge up the battery if needed overnight.Overall, very happy with Sungen from start to finish. Recommended.

From start to finish, my experience with Sungen has been excellent. Howie came for a site inspection (even flying a drone to capture overhead photos) and took the time to clearly explain everything I needed to know about solar—how the system works, the installation process, and the savings I could expect on my energy bills.What stood out most was the transparency and professionalism. There were no hidden surprises or pushy sales tactics—just honest advice and a straightforward plan. Howie walked me through the expected return on investment, timelines, and even potential challenges, which gave me full confidence in moving forward.The installation was smooth, quick, and hassle-free. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and delivered exactly what was promised during the consultation—something that’s hard to come by these days.Sungen exceeded my expectations on every level: great service, quality installation, and total peace of mind knowing I made the right choice. If you’re considering solar, I can’t recommend them enough—you’ll be in very good hands!

The salesperson was responsive, engaged and sent through quotes for a number of options that I put forward. The quotes were competitive and the systems included all the features that I was looking for.The salesperson came for a site inspection, which included a drone flown up to take overhead pictures, but it didn't include a detailed solar path assessment or shade analysis. Whilst shading is an obvious issue at the site, the scale of the problem was not apparent in any of the quotes (even from other companies) and in reality, the system is only producing at around 40% of its max potential.After the quote was finalised, a small deposit was paid and installation scheduled. Then the Federal election was held and the Battery incentive was announced. After discussion with the salesperson, we split the system into two, with PV and EV charger installation first, then Battery after the incentive kicks in.The installation (carried out by experienced sub-contractors) was done professionally with no issues. They managed the complex roof without issue and even managed to squeeze in 2 additional panels.Once the battery incentive kicked in, an installation date was scheduled. However, a final price (after the new rebate) was never provided even up to the very last minute, which caused some frustrations. After escalations, a final price was agreed and installation went ahead without a hitch.The Sigen inverter, battery and AC EV charger operates very well together. The mySigen app is very flexible and allows granular controls of all components. Monitoring can also happen locally via Modbus (after turning it on in the Installer App, by the installer).At the end of it all, very happy with the system so far!

We recently had solar panels installed by Sungen and couldn’t be happier. This is the second time we have used them and the team was professional, friendly, and completed the job on time with no hassle. Jackson was very helpful in recommending the best solution for our house and worked with us to ensure the placement of the panels were where we wanted them to allow for future installation of some skylights.  Highly recommend Sungen for anyone considering solar!

From the moment I first reached out to Sungen, the entire process was seamless and stress-free. The initial contact was handled promptly and professionally, with the team taking the time to answer all my questions thoroughly, which gave me great confidence in their expertise. When it came to providing a quote, they were not only quick but also very transparent, clearly outlining all the costs and ensuring there were no hidden surprises.What really stood out was the team’s extensive knowledge and their flexibility in accommodating my specific requirements. They listened carefully to my needs, offered tailored advice, and made helpful recommendations that ultimately improved the outcome of the project. Their fairness in pricing and approach was evident throughout, making the decision to proceed with them an easy one.The installation phase was equally impressive. The installers were highly professional, and demonstrated great attention to detail. They managed the entire installation without causing any damage to my roof—remarkably, not a single roof tile was broken. Additionally, they were meticulous about cleanliness, ensuring that all work areas were tidied up before they left. They left everything in perfect order, which I truly appreciated.Overall, my experience with Sungen was outstanding, from start to finish. Their combination of professionalism, expertise, and customer-focused service makes them a company I would highly recommend to anyone considering similar work.

System is up and working well but installation was not ideal. Sales and quoting process was smooth and friendly. However the installation was not without its problems: Sungen were advised of the terracotta roof tiles and more care should have been taken with installation. At least 50 tiles were broken in the process of installation which meant I had to source additional second hand tiles as replacement at an extra cost to me  (even though I already had at least 20 tiles already on hand). I actually had to get up on the roof and replace at least 20 tiles myself. Of course the rubble of broken tiles were left behind and it was only after a few weeks that I was able to convince Sungen to come back and clean up. While I appreciate the tiles may have been brittle I don't think installation was approached in a very intelligent way. The panels had to be moved from the original planned installation position to one further back from the street which meant that shade become an issue. If I had to sum up the installation in one word I'd say: rough. It was all bit fast and furious even though some delays meant that installation took 3-4 days instead of the suggested one day.
Great service from the Sungen team. System seems to be performing very well so far. Will continue to monitor performance.

Liam, from Sungen was the only person who came to our house to see the setup. He also replaced our Goodwee inverter that had failed which had caused us a lot of pain due to the closing down of the previous installer.We added another 5.6kw to our existing system. I may have been able to get it cheaper from other installers but I choose Sungen because they came to our house to see what needed to be done.They presented a positive approach to the installation, their people are full time and they are a local company and I can call into their office if I have any issues.The installation was very professional and they fixed up an issue that I had with the previous installation.I would have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone who was installing solar panels in the future. Liam was very responsive and answered all my questions.

Salesman Liam was fairly straight-forward, open & honest.Installation was great, the guys worked extra hard to get the job done before the rain started, one of the electricians even stayed behind in the rain to finish up the job and get the battery setup & working which is greatly appreciated.16.8kWh system with 37 × 455W AIKO Solar Neostar 2STesla Powerwall 3So far so good, can't export waiting on the energy retailer but system is doing well do far (very early days however).

The sales person came to inspect our place which others didn't. The installation occurred on the day arranged without any delays or rescheduling. It was all done in half a day. They also helped get my meter replaced to the required type.The installers cleaned up afterwards and the place was left as it was initially.It is all up and running without issues.

Sale person patiently explaining technology, economy, installation process, after sale support, company history. Proposing a balance system between price and quality. Installation was just as described. In short, quality, price, customer service met customer expectation.

Jackson handled everything including connecting us with a solar friendly retailer to get us the best deal available the quote he give did not change,the install was seamless and tidy,his after sale service was faultless even when we had an issue 4 years after install ,turns out it was a poles and wires issue  which he had remedied by the supplier, it is fair to say I would recommend sungen solar without hesitation.

Yes, they were polite and helpful. They arranged grid connection and the smart meter installation. They were punctual and informative. Installation appears to be neat. They cleaned up after themselves. Overall it was a good experience.

Quotation process was efficient, although all done utilising the internet to view the property. Sign of the times and technology!Installation crew arrived a little earlier than scheduled, although it was not a problem as they needed the whole day to complete the installation, which included removal of a redundant solar system. They were polite, and reasonably tidy.All factors were completed including connection to the grid and liaison with our energy provider. Our only task being to enjoy the benefits of our solar energy system.
Everything was easy, from requesting the first quote through to the acceptance and booking in the install. The install took only have a day and looks and works brilliantly.

Liam from Sungen was very professional during the quotation process and also ensured installation was completed on time without any issues.  Duan and his team turned up on time and  worked extremely hard till late hours in the evening to complete the job.  They installed a 20kw system in one day, that's 46 panels on 3rd floor.   Amazing job.  They also organised the grid connection.  Once the system was turned on, it was up and running and I was getting feed in tariff the following day.  If you’re looking for someone that you can trust to complete the job on time with attention to detail I recommend Liam and Duan from Sungen.

I was referred to Jackson and Liam by a member of my family who had previously used Sungen and I was not let down. Jackson and his team were extremely helpful along my journey of selecting and installing Solar. The process was simple and seamless from the initial stages of packaging a system to match my needs, to installation with Duan’s team and assisting me in submission to my electrical retailer. I  am very satisfied with my decision to go with Sungen and could not recommend the team more.
The sales team were very knowledgeable and professional and the installation team were fantastic.

Fantastic experience working with both of these guys and their extended team of installers. I've engaged them both for my residential AND commercial property. They were flexible, great communication and all-round professionals at what they do. Cannot recommend them enough!

Sales quoting process was factual, honest without any push.Installation was polite and punctual and suitability tidy (it was a cloudy day with occasional rain).The customer service after installation was quite straightforward as they connected the inverter monitoring system almost instantly with the smart meter upgrade being organized for us in the advised time of 2 weeks post installation.We were only shown a photo of the panel layout on the installers device so nothing that I could retain.Probably the only note I could point out is the advice of the 2-way solar tariff that is coming up in the next year or so.As this information was already available, I would have appreciated being made aware of it during the quoting process.

From initial brief and scope of work Jackson and his team were extremely detailed in their work plans, quoting and installation process.We did our research and shortlisted two companies (from 6 different cost estimates) to tender final scope of works and price quotation.Jackson on first consultation came out to the property and evaluated our project. He was extremely detailed in his product selection and was very thorough with the proposal. He kept me informed all the way with progress and response to questions detailed. His project management skills and his team are highly credible. Liam is the site manager while Duan and his team of installers have the greatest attention to detail that I have seen or researched in this line of work. On completion as a customer of SUNGEN we were provided with a completed Job Pack that is a detailed completion report on the installation.I highly recommend Jackson and his team of SUNGEN. May not be the cheapest but certainly for us was the ideal choice for a long-term investment that will pay dividends ....Next project : Battery install and an EV charge port to come

Timely, tidy, good value, exactly what we wanted.They were dedicated to doing everything they could to keep the cabling internal, which was tricky and appreciated by us. The conduit at the inverter is plumb, level and square. The inverter is in the garage and we're prepared for future options. Panels are installed tidy and the available roof surfaces are well covered with generation.Many thanks to Sungen.

From start to finish, the solar installation experience with Sungen Solar has been one of complete professionalism with the entire team providing a friendly, competent and no fuss top notch service.  I was certainly in a safe set of hands.  Thanks team
Jackson and his team provide a great service. We highly recommend them.

After speaking to a few other solar providers and feeling like I was getting the sales pitch and recommended all the additions, I was referred to Jackson from a family member and very happy I asked around.Jackson was polite, responsive and informative and his quote came in under what the other providers quoted, and very happy with how much solar we're pulling in each day.He also provided me recommendations on which energy provider to switch to to make the best of our solar feed in.Highly recommend

We obtained several quotes and decided to proceed with Sungen, who provided a competitive quote for our system. Another deciding factor in proceeding with Sungen was the friendly and comprehensive customer service with the key callout of our interactions with Jackson. This great service would continue through to the installation and post installation process, including Jackson being contactable on the day of the installation whilst on leave.The installation was scheduled as promised and the three installers, led by Duan, arrived on time, completed the installation without issue and conducted themselves in a safe and professional manner (with appropriate WHS measures, especially for our high pitch roof). The team also reassessed the proposed placement of the PV panels to optimise the solar yield.As other Sungen customers have written, the customer service we experienced was fantastic throughout the entire process. Post installation, we informed our electricity retailer of the new solar PV system and supplied the paperwork provided by Sungen. The whole process was seamless that we were able to receive feed-in-tariffs for excess electricity generation as soon as the system was installed.
Everything was done on time in a very professional manner. All calls were answered or returned promptly.

I had a solar system installed 6 years ago by a company that has since disappeared. I contacted a total of 7 different companies to get quotes to either replace inverter or full system. One quote was for over $10k for a 6kW system. When I explained it was too expensive they offered a new quote with hardware that I could not locate on the manufacturer websites. Another company that does extensive advertising offered a cheap quote but after research on the web I found a number of bad reviews for both the company customer service and the hardware they offered.Liam from Sungen visited mid Dec and I could relate to his attitude. His knowledge of the system was very good. Other companies were offering installation in late Jan or Feb and Liam managed to get the installation completed by end of December. Very impressed with the amount of communication throughout the signing of the contract and installation. Jackson was on leave but managed to call me after the install to make sure I was happy with the install.So far, I have nothing but great respect for the service and product from Sungen and can highly recommend them.
The whole experience from the initial contact, installation, and after sales service was and is fantastic. The whole process was easy, with absolutely no drama.

I cannot recommend Jackson and the team at Sungen Solar highly enough! Jackson was amazing to deal with during the quoting process and very patient with all my questions. He clearly knows everything there is to know about solar. Liam, who came out to do the site assessment, and Duan and the team who did the install were absolute gentlemen and took so much care. The end result looks fantastic and is already saving us a fortune on our electricity bill. Sungen's quote was the equal most competitive of the 5 quotes we received, and Jackson was also the most impressive to deal with, making it a very easy decision to go with Sungen.

Overall experence withSungen was very good. Response from Liam who did the quote was quick and professional. He also did a site inspection promptly. Installers arrived as organised, were very efficient and tidy. Duan was exellent and took time to explain changes made to the original design. The original Redback invertor supplied had an issue and a replacement was provided a few days later and has been working normally. Jackson, the owner of the business is also very helpful, and always took my calls to answer all my questions and provide any advice. The system was only recently installed, but to date I am very happy with the install and performance.
FYI, costing is not part of this review. Installation was as discussed and on time. Everything so far has been well communicated.

Refreshing to deal with honest and a business with integrity. Provided pros and cons for all scenarios. The installation was super smooth and the team were highly professional. If we require an additional 3kWh of panels (we oversized the inverter) I will definitely be asking Sungen to do so.

Quoting process was carried out remotely with their specialist Jackson. He provided clear explanations and was quick on all the follow up queries. Ended up with a mid range system to maximise TCO vs ROI. 10yr installation warranty was a plus.Installation was carried out by Duan and a colleague. They took their time and carried out everything diligently. The team helped identify some issues with sarking and replaced some cracked tiles on other parts of the roof that I wasn't aware of. All in all very professional.

Extremely happy with the installation of my 6.45kW solar system by Sungen.The price was comparable to the other quotes but the service was excellent.The panels were installed within reasonable time around 2 weeks of paying the deposit.The installers were in-house and the job was completed in 6 hrs.They cleaned up everything on completion and took all the rubbish away.The team leader Duan the electrician coordinated everything and did a neat job of installing the Inverter and connections and explained the whole process.Also thanks to Liam and Jackson for their assistance in choosing the right product and follow up.

Excellent experience with Sungen Solar. I was referred by my friend to Sungen and Jackson, the sales rep could give me a detailed briefing on the options I could have for solar energy. Jackson did not go straight to sell an expensive system but had given you the context for the various options. Jackson was also responsible and provided proper follow up during the installation.
Sungen were easy to deal with and very informative. The quote was competitive and installation went off without any issues or problems. Highly recommend Sungen.

Quoting process was good, excellent follow up with providing alternatives to cater our needs.Installation went smoothly, after installation I waited for a few days for them to follow up but ended up I called them instead. They did help organise the grid connection with my energy provider. Overall, the Professionalism and knowledge, not trying to hard sell products we dont necessary need was the main reason I went for Sungen.

Liam came out to do a site survey and explain my options.Our site is reasonably straightforward as there is no shading on our large west facing roof surface.I mulled over various options with numerous calls/emails to both Liam and Jackson before deciding on a SMA inverter with REC panels. One of our requirements was a totally silent inverter - which ruled out most inverters with fans.  The SMA is fanless and totally silent.The Fronius Gen24 Symo would have been our first choice but there was no stock in 3 phase 10kW at time of order. I preferred the Fronius reporting interface and the integrated backup power point.  It has a fan but it is still very quiet.Installation was performed by Duan and a colleague.  There was a last minute revision to the panel layout due to screw line spacing of the Colorbond roof.  The revised layout worked out better for roof and gutter access without compromising PV production.The duo worked non-stop fitting the 33 panels on Clenergy Hollywood racking.System was producing the following day with a textbook production curve on the first clear day.I've been very pleased with the professionalism of the Sungen team, in particular - Liam, Jackson and Duan.

Liam and Jackson were very patient, direct to the point, and able to explain and articulate things clearly. The team were flexible with discussing our concerns and our requirements.Installation occurred on an extremely hot day. I was shocked to see a smaller than expected team. Nonetheless the installation was completed punctually, the team were friendly and polite, and the entire process went seamlessly.After sales support has been great, with the additional helpful advice by the team and the ongoing support through to our energy retailer.

The sales and quoting process went well although banana solar were slower to respond and did not answer my technical questions completely. The solar quotes background information is great and allowed me to compare the quotes technically correctly.Installation by Sungen was professional, seamless and punctual. Very helpful people.Customer service by Sungen is excellent with good follow-up and response to my silly questions.Everything has worked well from day one include the online monitoring function.

Highly recommend Sungen! Both Liam and Jackson were patient, very knowledgeable, provided all the pros and cons of the different systems we inquired about, and didn't try to push us or oversell. In the end we chose a 13.7kWh array (33x415w Trina Vertex S+) with Enphase microinverters, and couldn't be happier with the results.Removed my old 5.4kWh system (30x180w UpSolar panels with SMA 5000TL inverter) and installed the new one with little trouble. Originally was going to install 32 panels, but installer managed to install 33 panels, maximising my roof space and the Enphase relay. Site was cleaned up afterward, with all rubbish removed offsite.Will be calling them back when we decide to install a battery.
Jackson has and continues to provide fantastic advise, customer service and has delivered as promised.  From installation to after s support, everything has been great and I would highly recommend.

Choosing a solar system is an important investment, where professionalism, product knowledge and trust are important.That’s why we choose Sungen.An onsite appointment was made following our initial inquiry, to assess our actual requirements, where suggested products were clearly explained with various options.Given the many other quotes we looked at, Sungen was very reasonable and comprehensive based on confirmed site conditions, unlike others who simply offered a price on the phone or email.This professional approach from the Manager to the Installers confirmed our confidence in going with Sungen

The team at Sungen was an absolute pleasure to deal with. After getting multiple quotes, they came out to be the cheapest and supplied my desired brands of the panels & inverter. If you are after Solar Power, do not hesitate to contact the team.

Our experience with Sungen was excellent from the initial sales enquiry all the way through to post installation assistance. The team are knowledgeable and helpful, never pushy like other companies. They also offer a superior product at competitive rates with long warranties. This is in stark contrast to the cheap systems peddled by cricketers on TV. Highly recommend.

Happy to review Sungen, I selected them after receiving quotes from a number of other installers,and I have to say they listened to what I wanted and supplied quotes with a number of options, explained the various pros and cons allowing me to choose, without pressure, and installed it in one long day cleanly and without any fuss.A big thanks and an A+++ from me.

Liam and Jackson were wonderful to deal with. Liam was clear on what to expect from the install, quality of components used etc.The installation team was on time, efficient and accommodated my requests on placement of Inverter (which was a bit tricky given the constraints). The installation was tidy and compact. The installation on the roof was clean, straight and professional.

Sales person gave valid advice and specific solutions.  Installation is quick and professional and reliable. They helped in coordinating with energy company in the installation of smart metre afterwards.

Quick to respond and clearly articulated Solar brands (compared to car brands and got the Toyota). Didn’t visit the house though so layout was changed during installation. But all good as solar working excellent!

Quoting process was thorough , it took a lot of research and a  few options before  finally settling  on the more expensive micro inverter system . The system was installed much sooner than we expected . Installation was completed in a day , a neat and tidy job with skilled installers .There was an issue  getting the enaphase system to show the data . This turned out to be a poor signal  with our Wi Fi and was rectified with a Wi fi booster set up in the room behind our meter box . Our installer Duan visited several times to find the issue and show us how to fix it.Everyone we met in this company was very competent , helpful  and easy to work with.

The company came out to my home and talked to me about my special problems and concerns. They were helpful, communicative, on time and thoroughly professional from quote to installation. I can unreservedly recommend them.

Jackson was a great person to deal with. He listened to our needs and found the best solution for our situation without overselling. Very prompt service. Installers were clean and efficient without cutting corners. Looking forward to getting the most out of our investment for many years to come and feel confident that Sungen will look after us.
Great experience, Jackson from Sungen Energy went above and beyond in providing support throughout the entire process. Pure pleasure in dealing with this company, highly recommended.

Jackson and his team were excellent! Jackson was fantastic throughout  the entire process from finding the best system for our needs.From the time the quote was made to the home visit, to being very prompt and efficient in the  installation by his team . Not stressful at all and the panels look beautiful. I could not praise Sungen enough and would highly reccommend them!Thank you Sungen.MV

Sungen gave us well-informed, reliable and refreshingly candid advice without any hard sell. They were flexible and responded well to our request to change the plan as we went along. They also took pains to keep us updated at each stage of the process. The installation was smooth and thorough and we are very happy with the result.
All went like clockwork from start to finish nice and friendly staff will recommend you use this company i will Ross.

Had a Enphase system installed by Sungen, whole process was great, they were happy to explain all the pros and cons of each option, final product is great. Did everything via satellite image without a follow up onsite visit though which proved a little frustrating when they came to install and found my new tv antenna was in the way and my roof beams were spaced in such a way they couldn't fit as many panels on the NW side as they had planned. Installers were very accomodating though and happy with the final result.
Great advice and recommendations on size of the system and look of the system. Installation went well with no issues and time to answer my questions.

I found Jackson Munro pleasant to talk to, very helpful and did not upsell.The installation was completed a week after I paid the deposit and I am satisfied the installation was done professionally.The inverter app was installed on my phone and grid connection organised by Sungen.There was a curtesy call after completion.I am pleased with the performance of the system and would not hesitate to recommend Sungen.

Summary points:- process was faster and more efficient then expected- friendly sales service and good installation crew- went for slightly larger system (8.3kw) due to advice that shading over the house would impact output, but so far even on cloudy days the output more than meets our needs, so probably should have gone for smaller system.

If I were to pick the best thing, they were very competitively priced. I got the latest Jinko N-Type all-black panels + SolarEdge inverter. You also get 10 years workmanship warranty for that price. What gave me confidence is that they have a lot of experience doing both many large commercial rollouts as well as residential. James is a legend and Ervan knows his stuff.The only hiccup was that they forgot to submit the paperwork to my energy provider so I went about a month without earning a feed-in tariff. Make sure you jump on that.
Quote supplied overnight after onsite assessment.Quality installation provided over several days due to size of the system and poor weather.Customer service including follow up has been brilliant

Starting from sales I noticed slight push towards what has to be sold, not my requirements. Other than such small push I was explained most of what I asked for and quote was clear with what will be done for its price. I did my homework so was fine with sales with one exception - I was sold metering from Goodwe by being told it was required to have export limit. Turned that for this particular inverter limit is based on CT coil directly connected to the inverter. and metering had nothing to do with it. I wanted metering, however, for its price I would rather install something with better API saving myself from writing python scripts to operate Goodwe kit.Installing wasn't as smooth. I must say, subcontracted installer was skilled and was able to install cables in wall cavities which weren't easy to operate within. At the end install looks nice. However, there were problems. First CT coil and metering was missing on delivery. No-one noticed. I was able to organize metering kit delivered second day but in relation to CT coil I was told I have no idea what is required. Turned I was right, they had to come two weeks later to add coil and this time cables weren't installed nicely. Next issue I noticed was panels stringed 13-13-10. Again, I was told this will be OK. It was not, it rendered system hardly usable from mid November till when it was rewired into 3x12 late December.It took substantial effort from myself to actually show why it does not work as expected. Last issue is with clamping zones, one row of panels has it off by around 10%.On top of that some settings were initially incorrect (output limit to 50%, frequency allowed too narrow, etc) and had to be corrected after first light over a few weeks.Despite the above I believe they were one of good installers, just not experienced with rare inverter and with assumption the customer is never smart. I had my roof condition reviewed by roofer who covers roof warranty and it turned all OK.
Very satisfied with the service, installation and operation of the system

Due to our very high electricity bills we have decided to check out the solar panel options which are available today. Our old 2011 1.5kw system had already recovered the install costs but was not helping with reducing our bills.After a fair amount of research into the market, technologies etc. (Solarquotes was of great help) we concluded that it would make sense to replace the old system with a new one. To optimise ROI and minimise bills, it would have to be at the high end of the spectrum, 8-10kw and we would have to maximise to number of panels that could be fitted on the available roof area. Our view was that the most cost effective system would be based on a premium invertor (10 year warranty) and mid-range solar panels.We invited eight installers to quote on a system based on this brief.Sungen (one of the three installers recommended by Solarquotes) stood out with the best proposal for a very competitive price. It was based on Fronius Symo 10kw invertor with 40 Trina SplitMax 315W panels totalling 12.6kW. For this the panels would have to be installed in landscape mode (horizontally) which many installers do not support due to additional complexity. We also had Fronius Smart Meter included so that we can fully monitor the output.From the initial quotation to the completion everything went very smoothly. The Sungen people I dealt with: Jackson (Sales), Chris (Install) and Ervan (Ops) have been very professional and a pleasure to deal with.The system has been operational now for more than a month and we are very happy with the quality of the install and the generated output.
